items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: Yeah, just like one of our names was Ariane.

ctx.x: Yeah. They just started to call him that, I think, and he just decided to change his name because everybody was calling him George Lewis.
Yeah, just like one of our names was Ariane. Well, Ariane, you see. Well, after I got things straight, then I said, well, I just let it stay like that.
But after I got from this Christian organization, then I had to have everything correct, you see. Yeah. Yeah.
